code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    candidates = []
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            candidates.append((grid[r][0], "row", r))
    for c in range(1, w - 1):
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        if len(set(vals)) == 1:
            candidates.append((vals[0], "col", c))
    if not candidates:
        raise ValueError("No uniform separator found")
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    color, axis, index = min(candidates, key=lambda item: counts[item[0]])
    if axis == "row":
        panel = [row[:] for row in grid[index + 1:]]
    else:
        panel = [row[index + 1:] for row in grid]
    flat = [v for row in panel for v in row]
    background = Counter(flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
    background_out = 1 if background == 8 else background
    return [[background_out if v == background else 3 for v in row] for row in panel]
'''

code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    split = None
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        if r == h - r - 1 and len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            split = ("row", r)
            break
    if split is None:
        for c in range(1, w - 1):
            if c == w - c - 1 and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1:
                split = ("col", c)
                break
    if split is None:
        raise ValueError("No centered uniform separator found")
    axis, index = split
    if axis == "row":
        first = grid[:index]
        second = grid[index + 1:]
    else:
        first = [row[:index] for row in grid]
        second = [row[index + 1:] for row in grid]
    common = set(v for row in first for v in row) & set(v for row in second for v in row)
    if len(common) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"Expected one shared color, got {common}")
    shared = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if a == shared and b == shared else shared for a, b in zip(row_a, row_b)]
